subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 19, 2026
body:
**August 19, 2026 AcreetionOS Newsletter**

**Firefox 154.0 Released**

The latest version of the Firefox browser, 154.0, has been released, bringing with it several important changes, including extended local network access permissions. This update is now available for download and installation.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively engaged in discussions on our Discord server, with many users sharing their experiences and feedback on the latest version of the distribution.
* Our GitLab instance has seen a significant increase in activity, with several new contributors joining the project and contributing to various aspects of the distribution.

**Practical Tip**

* Did you know that you can customize the appearance of your AcreetionOS desktop by modifying the Cinnamon theme? To do so, simply navigate to the Cinnamon settings and select the "Themes" tab. From there, you can browse and install new themes or modify the existing ones to suit your preferences.

**Stay up-to-date with the latest AcreetionOS news and updates by visiting our website at [acreetionos.org](https://acreetionos.org).**
